name: p2-round3-screen
budget_note: final budgeted round; direction (price-volume mean reversion) nominated by the user 2026-09-17; 8 of 12 configs; per plan §6 three consecutive rounds without a survivor force a return to the discussion layer

data.price_convention: signals on adjusted levels (close*adj_factor; z-scores on the adjusted series); tradability gates on unadjusted prices; pctChg/turn in percent

R3-mr-z-oversold.hypothesis: 收盘对自身20日均值的z分数<=-1.5的超卖偏离会向均值回归，次开进场持有3/5日费用后优于同池基准
R3-mr-z-oversold.from_prior_rounds: deviation-from-own-trend is a distinct lens from round-1 raw 5-day return

R3-mr-shrink-dip.hypothesis: 缩量下跌（5日跌幅<=-5% 且当日量<=0.7×20日均量）表明卖压衰竭，随後修复，费用后优于同池基准
R3-mr-shrink-dip.from_prior_rounds: round 2 showed the high-volume slice keeps falling; this is its untested complement

R3-mr-z-shrink-combo.hypothesis: 价格偏离与成交萎缩同时出现（z<=-1.0 且 量<=0.8×均量）时均值回归更强，费用后优于同池基准
R3-mr-z-shrink-combo.from_prior_rounds: interaction of the two round-3 axes

R3-mr-z-confirmed.hypothesis: 前一日z<=-1.5且当日收涨（回归确认后入场，不接飞刀）持有3/5日费用后优于同池基准
R3-mr-z-confirmed.from_prior_rounds: round-1 unconditional knife-catching failed; this enters only after a bounce confirms

execution.entry: next session open after signal close

fees.disclosure: stamp duty segments are institutional facts; commission segments are conservative assumed retail rates, NOT the user's actual fee (actual 万1 all-in, P3 scope); transfer fee ~0.001% omitted

validation.isolation: dev events must exit on or before 2020-12-31; validation events have signal_date >= 2021-01-01
validation.freeze: events whose hold crosses 2024-12-31 flagged horizon_out_of_range
validation.history_note: 2015-2024 inspected by the old project: rolling historical validation, never unseen-sample proof

dev_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on dev
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 4 of 6 dev years
top-decile symbol share of total net profit <= 40%
validation_pass: mean net per completed event beats pool_equal_weight mean on validation
per-year net edge vs pool positive in >= 2 of 4 validation years
selection_rule.multiple_testing: 8 preregistered configs in round 3 (9 + 6 + 8 = 23 cumulative); survivors at most 2 proceed to P3; any post-hoc re-picking downgrades to exploratory; this is the final budgeted round before mandatory re-orientation

benchmarks.pool_equal_weight: per signal date, mean adjusted open-to-open return over all eligible symbols on identical calendar windows (no fees)
benchmarks.random_pick: 3 random eligible picks on every trading day through the identical event pipeline, seed 17

kill_criteria_note: mid/high slippage tiers are P3 scope; P2 runs tier-0 (no slippage) only
